transcriptionRule#0.text: When the options (A)–(D) are themselves drawings, graphs, diagrams or images, describe EVERY option separately, one line each, starting with its letter: "(A): <what it shows>", "(B): …", in order. For each, say the features that decide whether it is right (direction, sign, shape, labels, values, what is connected), so a reader who cannot see it can tell the options apart. Never merge two options into one line.
